async function smelt3RawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process aims to produce three iron ingots if they are not already present in the inventory. It first checks if enough raw iron is available to meet the required amount. If a furnace is not nearby, it attempts to place one. Then, it selects an appropriate fuel source based on what is available. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron using the chosen fuel to achieve the target ingot count.
